test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 15 Nov 2021 Shift 2
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct indirect narration of the given sentence.**

My neighbour said to me, “I’m sorry but I will not be able to accompany you to the theatre as my mother is unwell.”

options.text: My neighbour apologises she will not be able to accompany me to the theatre as her mother is unwell.
My neighbour apologised to me saying that she would not be able to accompany me to the theatre as her mother was unwell.
My neighbour apologised that she was not being able to accompany me to the theatre as my mother was unwell.
My neighbour apologised to her saying that she would not be able to accompany me to the theatre as her mother was unwell.

solution:
The correct answer is: **My neighbour apologised to me saying that she would not be able to accompany me to the theatre as her mother was unwell.** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The given sentence is a direct speech and we need to convert it into an indirect speech.
 
• We follow these rules in Direct-Indirect speech:
 
 
• The reporting verb 'said' changes to 'apologised'. When '**sorry**' is mentioned in the direct speech then it became an apology in the indirect speech.
 
• When the direct part is written in **1st person's narrative statement** then we use **'saying that'** to connect the clause in the indirect speech.
 
• The pronoun 'I' changes to 'me' and '**my**' changes to '**her**' in the indirect part.
 
• The pronoun '**you**' changes to '**me**' in the indirect speech.
 
• The modal '**will**' in the direct speech changes to '**would**' in the indirect speech.
 
• The inverted commas ("...") is replaced with the preposition 'to' to show the indirect speech part.
 
• The comma (,) is omitted to show the indirect speech part.
 
• The first word of the indirect speech is in capital letters.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is option 2.

The indirect sentence is: *My neighbour apologised to me saying that she would not be able to accompany me to the theatre as her mother was unwell.*
